objects-require-non-null.title: Require a non-null reference
objects-require-non-null.summary: Validate required references at the boundary.
objects-require-non-null.why: Objects.requireNonNull makes a non-null contract explicit and fails close to the point where an invalid reference enters the object or method.
objects-require-non-null.tips: Use it for values that are genuinely required; if absence is meaningful, model that case instead of converting every null into an exception.

try-finally-semantics.title: try and finally semantics
try-finally-semantics.short: Run cleanup whether work succeeds or fails
try-finally-semantics.summary: Use finally for cleanup that must run after a try block.
try-finally-semantics.why: A finally block normally runs when control leaves try, including through return or an exception, making it suitable for cleanup that is not represented by AutoCloseable.
try-finally-semantics.tips: Prefer try-with-resources for closeable resources, and avoid returning from finally because it can hide an earlier result or exception.

list-copy-of.title: Create an unmodifiable list copy
list-copy-of.summary: Create an unmodifiable List from an existing collection.
list-copy-of.why: List.copyOf separates the resulting list from later structural changes to the source and clearly states that callers should not mutate the result.
list-copy-of.tips: Null elements are rejected. The elements themselves are not deep-copied, so mutable element objects can still change.

string-strip.title: Strip Unicode whitespace
string-strip.summary: Remove leading and trailing Unicode whitespace.
string-strip.why: String.strip uses Java's Unicode-aware whitespace definition and is generally a better fit for modern text than the older trim method.
string-strip.tips: strip does not handle null. Use stripLeading or stripTrailing when only one side should be removed.

empty-stack-exception.title: Popping an empty Stack
empty-stack-exception.short: Check that an element exists before pop
empty-stack-exception.summary: Avoid EmptyStackException when using legacy Stack.
empty-stack-exception.why: Stack.pop and Stack.peek require at least one element and throw EmptyStackException when the stack is empty.
empty-stack-exception.tips: For new code, Deque implementations are usually preferred for stack behavior; whichever type is used, make the empty case explicit.

malformed-url-exception.title: Malformed URL text
malformed-url-exception.summary: Handle MalformedURLException when constructing legacy URL values.
malformed-url-exception.why: The URL constructor rejects text whose protocol or overall syntax cannot be interpreted as a URL.
malformed-url-exception.tips: For modern URI handling, consider URI and validate external input separately; parsing success does not prove that a remote resource exists.

abstract-method-not-implemented.title: Abstract method is not implemented
abstract-method-not-implemented.summary: A concrete class must provide inherited abstract methods.
abstract-method-not-implemented.why: A non-abstract class implementing an interface or extending an abstract class must supply implementations for all remaining abstract methods.
abstract-method-not-implemented.tips: Check the exact method signature and @Override annotation. Mark the class abstract only when incomplete implementation is intentional.

duplicate-case-label.title: Duplicate case label
duplicate-case-label.short: Each switch case value must be distinct
duplicate-case-label.summary: Remove repeated constant labels from a switch.
duplicate-case-label.why: Two case labels with the same constant value would describe the same branch selection, so Java rejects the duplicate at compile time.
duplicate-case-label.tips: If several distinct values share behavior, group supported labels rather than repeating the same value.

unchecked-method-invocation-warning.title: Unchecked method invocation warning
unchecked-method-invocation-warning.short: Do not pass raw generic values into typed APIs
unchecked-method-invocation-warning.summary: Preserve generic type information across method calls.
unchecked-method-invocation-warning.why: Calling a parameterized method with a raw argument bypasses some compile-time type checks and can move a type mismatch to runtime.
unchecked-method-invocation-warning.tips: Remove raw types at their source. At unavoidable legacy boundaries, isolate and validate the conversion in one small place.

nan-equality-check.title: NaN cannot be detected with equality
nan-equality-check.summary: Test floating-point NaN with the dedicated predicate.
nan-equality-check.why: IEEE floating-point NaN is unequal to every value, including itself, so comparing a value with Double.NaN using == never identifies NaN.
nan-equality-check.tips: Use Double.isNaN or Float.isNaN and consider separately how infinities should be handled in numeric input.
